title: English Practice Quiz 0096
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The manager signed the letter.'
options: The letter was signed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.
